scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @gost-kit/common && npm run build --workspace @gost-kit/svelte && npm run build --workspace @gost-kit/prettier-config && npm run build --workspace @gost-kit/eslint-config && npm run build --workspace @gost-kit/eslint-config-svelte
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run check:tooling && npm run test:tooling && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run check --workspaces && npm test && npm --prefix examples/functional-core run check:code
scripts.version:packages: npm run build --workspace @gost-kit/prettier-config && changeset version && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts && npm --prefix examples/functional-core install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts
scripts.fix: npm run lint:fix && npm run format
